written_before: any dataset row, pool or candidate was downloaded or looked at
revision: the dataset commit SHA current at preparation time; recorded in tasks/swe1/grading_meta.json and tasks/swe2/grading_meta.json

rule.order: ids = sorted(instance_id of the pool) (Python sorted on the string); random.Random(seed).shuffle(ids)  -- one fresh Random(seed) per pool
rule.pick: walk ids in that order; the first instance that passes environment validation is the task; every instance tried before it is recorded with the reason it was skipped
rule.environment_validation: repo snapshot at base_commit (git archive, no .git), Python version from the SWE-bench harness spec for the instance's pytest version (uv-managed CPython), harness pip_packages + the repo installed editable; in a scratch copy: every FAIL_TO_PASS test fails (or is missing) before and passes after applying gold patch + test_patch; every PASS_TO_PASS test passes both before and after; tests run as the harness does (pytest -rA on the files touched by test_patch, statuses parsed from the -rA summary; PASSED/XFAIL = pass)
